claim.en: Korčok has been a Slovak diplomat since 1992, serving as ambassador to Germany and the United States and in EU and Swiss postings.
claim.sk: Korčok pôsobí v slovenskej diplomacii od roku 1992, bol veľvyslancom v Nemecku a USA a pôsobil v štruktúrach EÚ a vo Švajčiarsku.

findings.identity: names former foreign minister Ivan Korčok announcing his presidential candidacy
findings.quote: Former diplomat Korčok entered the Slovak diplomatic service in 1992. He was an ambassador to Germany and the US, and served in the Council of the European Union and at the embassy in Switzerland.
findings.title: Ivan Korčok, ex-Slovak MFA, announces presidential run

claim.en: Nominated by SaS, Korčok served as Slovakia's foreign minister from 2020 until he stepped down in September 2022.
claim.sk: Korčok bol na nomináciu SaS ministrom zahraničných vecí od roku 2020 až do odstúpenia v septembri 2022.

findings.identity: names former foreign minister Ivan Korčok announcing his presidential candidacy
findings.quote: In 2020, he was nominated by the SaS as foreign minister, a post which he held until stepping down in September last year.
findings.title: Ivan Korčok, ex-Slovak MFA, announces presidential run
